implementationScope: package-only resource-aware DecodedImage finalization capability that keeps framework-private materialization authority visible and deliberately does not advertise the existing public finalization protocol
requiredInvariants: All packed, no-copy provider and DecodedImage geometry/color/resource facts from v3 remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

A second independent session fed the same source through the same 17-byte arbitrary-chunk schedule must expose ProgressiveImageDecodedImageResourceFinalizingSession when viewed only as any ImageProgressiveDecodeSession.
The same session must not advertise the existing public ProgressiveImageFinalizingSession while Core Graphics materialization operation authority remains unknown.
Resource-aware finalization sourceByteCount equals the complete 787-byte encoded body and its provider SHA equals the packed RGB SHA.

The capability returns the exact same materialization resource ledger as the qualified materializer, including operationPeak unknown(frameworkPrivateOperationAllocation) and transferredOutput bounded to 897 codec-owned RGB8 bytes.

Resource-aware finalization terminalizes and fully reclaims the session. This version makes unknown authority transportable through the host-facing package contract; it does not close the unknown or promote the backend publicly.
